feedback.text: Incorrect. Target hardening aims to increase the physical difficulty, time, and risks required to breach a building or person, deterring rational opportunist criminals.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Target hardening aims to increase the physical difficulty, time, and risks required to breach a building or person, deterring rational opportunist criminals.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Target hardening aims to increase the physical difficulty, time, and risks required to breach a building or person, deterring rational opportunist criminals.
